# Konno et al. 1999 pollinator-exclusion table

This directory records the 60-species experiment reported by Konno et al.
(1999), *Fruit set ratio of flowers subjected to bagging treatment for 60
plant species inhabiting Obihiro and its vicinity*, Wildlife Conservation
Japan 4(1):49–58, DOI `10.20798/wildlifeconsjp.4.1_49`.

The original J-STAGE PDF was retrieved on 2026-08-12 from
`https://www.jstage.jst.go.jp/article/wildlifeconsjp/4/1/4_KJ00003136398/_pdf/-char/en`.
Its SHA-256 is
`e76be3b39632141cf94a64269b8ec120a21ca14a3b936fa86bb1500751bc7baf`.
The PDF is not redistributed here. `konno_1999_bagging_table.csv` is a
line-by-line transcription of Table 1, checked against rendered pages 52 and
53 at 300 dpi.

The experiment bagged flowers or inflorescences at the bud stage to exclude
flower-visiting insects and compared fruit-set ratios with unbagged controls.
Consistent with the repository's existing Rodger et al. pollinator-exclusion
contract, a positive measured bagged fruit set records autonomous reproductive
capacity and a measured zero records absence. Hand-selfed treatments,
self-compatibility labels, mating-system labels, and pollen-vector labels are
not substituted.
